The '''Durkteel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durkteel/Legends|Durkteel]].
